title: Introduce RAG multi-tenant caching and telemetry quickstart
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Adds a new quickstart that demonstrates a multi-tenant RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) deployment pattern with tenant-aware caching policies, per-tenant routing to model variants, and telemetry-driven rollout rules. Motivation: teams building multi-tenant LLM features often need patterns for isolating tenant cache semantics, measuring per-tenant latency and quality, and safely rolling model/quantization changes. This quickstart provides an opinionated reference: a TypeScript runner that simulates concurrent tenant workloads, a Python adapter demonstrating how to implement prefix/KV cache namespaces and token-bucket rate-limiting per tenant, a Helm overlay for deploying a lightweight tenant-aware caching sidecar, and docs/guides that show how to wire Redwood routing policies for tiered fallbacks and metric-driven rollouts. Checklist: [x] example runner and adapter, [x] Helm overlay and kustomize snippet, [x] docs site snippet and quickstart README, [x] e2e smoke CI job, [x] telemetry dashboards examples. How to use: follow quickstarts/multi-tenant-caching/README.md to run the TS runner (npm install && npm run simulate) and start the Python adapter for local dev; the Helm overlay can be applied against a Dedicated or Private dev cluster to exercise routing fallbacks and per-tenant caching. Security notes: sample KMS/HSM integrations are mocked; do not use sample keys in production. Related: ENG-4892 (tenant isolation initiative), PM-210 (multi-tenant rollout UX).
